lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Top plate to end plate, ~89.6 deg. Sections at 25/50/75% show a clean R~4 outer arc with the label on its apex (outer apex minus label 0.00/-0.01/-0.01 mm; nearest point 0.05-0.37 mm). A station scan finds the fold apex from t=0 to ~56 mm of the 57.2 mm line. It runs out at both corner/miter blends, so the line covers the whole straight fold.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Top plate to side flange 5, ~90 deg. Sections at 25/50/75% have the label on the outer apex (0.00/0.00/0.02 mm). The fold apex runs from t=0 to ~121 mm of the 121.7 mm line, from the free end to the corner blend with B1/B4.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Top plate to side flange 7, ~90.2 deg. Sections at 25/50/75% have the label on the outer apex (0.04/0.00/-0.02 mm). The fold apex runs from t=0 to ~121 mm of the 121.9 mm line, the full fold length.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: End plate to the end-plate side flange on the 5 side, ~90 deg. Sections at 25/50/75% have the label on the outer apex (0.00/0.01/0.01 mm). The fold runs from the relief notch (below it only the flat end plate continues; apexY is about +3.2 mm, i.e. on the plate plane) up to the miter corner at t~62 mm. The line spans the whole fold.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: End plate to the end-plate side flange on the 7 side, ~89.9 deg. Sections at 25/50/75% have the label on the outer apex (-0.02/0.00/0.04 mm). The line runs from the relief notch to the miter corner (t 0 to ~62 mm), the full fold.
